_comment: Six hand-curated golden demo questions for the leadership script (F9.1) and the Pages showcase build (F8.3). Each names the expected level word and family; the answer, card, switches and citations are recorded at build time when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is present. These reference the real QualiZeal corpus (products NexaAI / QMentisAI / ValidAIte / QualiCentral, the company and its services).

questions.question: What is ValidAIte?
questions.note: A definition backed by the ValidAIte product document; cited to the page, Level 1.

questions.question: Compare QMentisAI and ValidAIte for AI system testing.
questions.note: Cross-product comparison; Level 3 with relationships and the two products cited.

questions.question: What services does QualiZeal offer for AI and ML model quality assurance?
questions.note: Service scope synthesised across service documents.

questions.note: A procedure drawn from the delivery / quality documents.
